title: Document type sorter
instruction: Say what type of business document this pasted or scanned text is.

labels.name: Invoice
labels.definition: A bill from a seller asking the buyer to pay an amount by a due date.

labels.name: Receipt
labels.definition: Proof that a payment has already been made, such as a till slip or payment confirmation.

labels.name: Purchase order
labels.definition: A buyer's order to a supplier listing what they want to purchase, often with a PO number and delivery details.

labels.name: Quote
labels.definition: A seller's price offer or estimate for goods or services that is valid for a limited time and not yet accepted.

labels.name: Shipping notice
labels.definition: A notice that goods have been dispatched, are in transit or have been delivered, usually with tracking or carrier details.

labels.name: Other
labels.definition: Any other document, such as letters, contracts, statements, packing lists that are not shipping notices, agendas or certificates.

business_rules: The model only picks the document type. It never reads, extracts or checks any amount, date or total in the text.
Low-confidence predictions go to a manual-sort pile instead of a type folder.
